review_method: Manual source/interface review tied to exact frozen source bytes; separate from automatic trace arithmetic.
findings: run_simulation constructs controller_state={} as a local variable for every invocation, so previous runs cannot share filter history.
Depth observations are sampled at the common control schedule. Bias/dropout/noise are applied before commands receives the observation dictionary.
The command interface receives controller ID, current perturbed observations, static asset geometry/max-depths, configured parameters, and only that run's local state.
The controller stores previous measured depth, a short increment history, offset hypothesis and control-depth history; its aggregate cap uses current and prior control-depth estimates.
Controller source imports math and statistics.median and reads no files, request catalog, solver object, rainfall, seed, future state, heldout results or post-run metrics.
Reference and candidate retain the same v2 information-boundary identifier in all eight checked development treatment contexts.

The final metadata-only difference from the 88-call cap-development source is resetting aggregate_cap_scale=1.0 for displayed diagnostics. Policy formulas and explicit selected parameters are unchanged.
conclusion: The inspected fixed controller uses causal memory of the same permitted depth observations, with isolated state and no expanded external observable set.

content.change: The v2 identifier names isolated per-run memory of current and past instances of the same permitted depth observations. It introduces no additional observation source.
permitted_information: Current possibly noisy or biased measured depths
Earlier instances of those same measured depths stored in isolated per-run state
Declared static model geometry and controller parameters
prohibited_information: Noise-free true simulator depth as a separate control input
Active fault catalog, timing, type or hidden status
Future observations, terminal metrics or heldout outcomes
invariant_requirements: Every reference and candidate run uses the same v2 experiment/context information-boundary identifier
Controller state is constructed empty inside every run_simulation invocation
Controller code receives only observations, static geometry, parameters and its isolated state
unchanged: All development and heldout acceptance thresholds
The fixed development pair and reference policy
content.chronology: This clarification is recorded after phase 2 controller development began but before any phase 2 heldout execution or outcome. It is a disclosed identifier deviation, not a revision of the frozen protocol bytes.
content.authorization: Root agent accepted this semantic treatment before phase 2 execution; genuine expansion of the observable set is not authorized by this clarification.
content.required_report_statement: Phase 2 used causal-depth-history-feedback-v2 instead of the protocol's v1 identifier. A pre-execution clarification records isolated history of the same permitted observations; no transforms or acceptance criteria changed.

limitations: This is a source review of the included fixed implementation, not a sandbox proof for arbitrary uploaded controllers.
An estimated sensor offset or aggregate-flow cap is not the true hydraulic state and cannot guarantee downstream flow or field safety.
The recorded v1-to-v2 identifier deviation remains explicit; frozen perturbations and criteria were not changed.
